sources.coverage: Best-efforts explanatory coverage; explicitly not a complete per-root registry.
Root status, fingerprint, trust-bit summary, EV metadata, and submitted record fields; not a complete Mozilla runtime restriction registry.
Program-wide requirements; not a fingerprint-keyed no-restrictions assertion.

coverage_notes: An omitted root record means unknown, never unrestricted.
A CCADB blank field or absent technical-constraint indicator does not establish absence of Mozilla code-level restrictions.
EV OID metadata describes EV treatment; it does not establish general TLS certificate-policy requirements or full RFC 5280 policy processing.
OneCRL and intermediate revocation remain outside root restrictions and are not represented here.
No candidate root currently has a complete, fingerprint-keyed assessment for all applicable restrictions.
